dish.title: Cashew Pesto Pasta
dish.name: Cashew Pesto Pasta
dish.description: Dairy-free basil pesto with toasted cashews, olive oil, lemon, and nutritional yeast, tossed with pasta boiled in salted water.

provenance.process: Legacy v1 corrected in draft only. Original authorship is not in the repo.
provenance.note: legacy_unknown. kitchen_tested is false. No cook count is known.

recipe_version.title: Cashew Pesto Pasta
recipe_version.description: Dairy-free basil pesto with toasted cashews, olive oil, lemon, and nutritional yeast, tossed with pasta boiled in salted water.
recipe_version.doneness: Pasta al dente. Pesto thick and glossy on the noodles, not watery.

ingredients.name: short pasta
ingredients.note: Durum wheat, such as penne or fusilli.

ingredients.name: raw cashews
ingredients.note: Toasted. Reserve 2 tbsp chopped for the top. This dish contains cashews and is not nut-safe.

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: Packed leaves, about 85 g. Added at the end of blending.

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp in the pesto, 1 tsp on the tomatoes, the rest as a finish.

ingredients.name: nutritional yeast
ingredients.note: Savory stand-in for cheese. Not dairy.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 28 g in 3 qt pasta water (about 1% by weight), 2.5 g in the pesto, 0.5 g on the tomatoes. 31 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (11 tsp). The same weight is 6.5 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 5.25 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: For boiling the pasta. Up to 2 tbsp more only if the pesto will not blend.

steps.title: Toast the cashews
steps.body: Toast the raw cashews in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden, 4 to 5 minutes. Reserve 2 tbsp, chopped, for the top.

steps.title: Blend the pesto
steps.body: Blend the remaining cashews with the garlic, lemon zest, 2 tbsp lemon juice, nutritional yeast, 2.5 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt, 3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, and the black pepper until thick. Add the basil and pulse until green and still a little coarse. Taste the pesto, which is meant to be eaten without further cooking, and add the remaining lemon juice if it tastes dull. No cheese: this pesto is dairy-free, and nutritional yeast plus salt replace the savoriness cheese would have brought.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.body: Bring the water to a boil with 28 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt (about 1% by weight, 28 g per 3 qt). Boil the short pasta until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of the salted pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Season the tomatoes
steps.body: Toss the cherry tomatoes with 1 tsp of the extra-virgin olive oil and the remaining 0.5 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt.

steps.title: Toss and finish
steps.body: Off the heat, toss the pasta with the pesto and 1/4 to 1/2 cup of the salted pasta water until the sauce looks glossy. Taste a noodle and add salt or lemon only if that bite needs it. Finish with the rest of the olive oil, the toasted cashews, and a few basil leaves.

recipe_version.time_note: Cashews are toasted 4 to 5 minutes, not soaked. Prep is 15 minutes and cook is 15. Heat the pasta water while the pesto is blended.

projection.allergen_note: Cashew and nuts are allergens, not dietary labels. Wheat is the durum pasta. Dietary labels are dairy_free and plant. Nutritional yeast is not dairy. Wheat is recorded even though the legacy allergen enum has no wheat id.

revision.reason_summary: The pesto calls for salt and blend water that were not ingredients, the cashew soak has no time inside a 25-minute total, and wheat is missing from the allergens.

evidence.note: Culinary review is a written judgment of the recipe text. It is not a kitchen test and not a household rating. Model confidence is not evidence of cooking.

culinary_revision.expected_flavor: Basil-forward pesto that coats pasta, with salt in the noodle and the sauce, olive oil to carry the herbs, and lemon at the end. Cashews are toasted instead of soaked.
culinary_revision.dietary: Still plant-based and dairy-free. Allergens remain cashew, nuts, and wheat. Not nut-safe. No miso, so no new soy allergen.
culinary_revision.safety: No raw animal food. Garlic and nuts are eaten as pesto, which is the dish.
culinary_revision.shopping: Olive oil, a whole lemon, more basil, and a weighed salt line replace the unsalted boil and the oil-free blend. Salt scales by servings; the 3 qt water is the 4-serving pot.
culinary_revision.uncertainties: Cashew toast color and basil bruising vary. The 1% pasta-water target is a ratio, and most of that salt stays in the pot.
culinary_revision.time_note: Cashews are toasted 4 to 5 minutes, not soaked. Prep is 15 minutes and cook is 15. Heat the pasta water while the pesto is blended.
culinary_revision.image_impact: 2026-10-18 hero is in public/images/meals. Independent audit of the exported WebP: PASS. Green oily pesto, toasted cashews, tomatoes, no dairy-looking topping. See docs/catalog/s08/IMAGE-PROVENANCE.md.
